run_policy_gradient_training: run policy gradient training on the catch environment with configurable algorithm and episode count
create_policy_gradient_agent: create a JAX-based policy gradient agent with configurable hidden layers, learning rates, and algorithm type
evaluate_policy_agent: evaluate a trained policy gradient agent over multiple episodes and return average reward
configure_training_flags: configure training flags for number of episodes, evaluation frequency, and algorithm selection
step_agent_in_environment: step a policy gradient agent in the catch environment to collect actions and update internal state
